acceptance.gate: Phase 5 gate G5 per master-plan v2.1 §9: (e_u, e_sigma_xx) within (0.01, 0.2), (0.005, 0.1), (0.002, 0.05) coarse-to-fine; fitted log-log slopes >= 2.3 / 2.2. NOTE DISCREPANCY: the source doc §6 requires only slope > 0.5 ('practical convergence check, not a claim of full asymptotic spline rate') — the plan's 2.3/2.2 rate gate is stricter than the documented criterion and Coreform's measured rates are 2.79/2.38. Record both; Phase 5 work order must resolve which gate binds.
acceptance.slope_requirement_source_doc: > 0.5 per quantity (least-squares fit of log e vs log h)
acceptance.volume_note: integrated domain volume must agree with t*(b^2 - pi*a^2/4), b = 4, within 0.1%

boundary_conditions.artificial_outer_boundary: x=4 and y=4 faces carry the exact Kirsch displacement (supplied by Abaqus DISP subroutine in the reference; WHT_IGA must impose the same closed form)
boundary_conditions.symmetry: u_x = 0 on x=0; u_y = 0 on y=0
boundary_conditions.through_thickness: u_z = 0 everywhere (plane strain, incl. nonzero out-of-plane stress); translated IGA model imposes displacement by penalty coefficient 1e10

geometry.domain: 0 <= x <= 4, 0 <= y <= 4, x^2 + y^2 >= a^2; 3D extrusion of fixed thickness t = 0.25 (plane strain)

materials.K_mu_ratio_note: K/mu ≈ 50000, making volumetric locking a demanding concern
materials.type: isotropic linear elastic, small-strain; NOT finite strain or plasticity

mesh_sweep.continuity: quadratic C^1 spline space for displacement AND independent pressure
mesh_sweep.formulation: U(2,C^1)/P(2,C^1) continuous pressure + VMS stabilization; static condensation, pressure macro-elements and discontinuous-pressure aggregation DISABLED

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §2 Geometry, §3 Material, §4 Loading & BC, §6 Kirsch closed form + error/volume/slope criteria, §7 Results (QoI table + fitted rates)

reference_values.analytical_peak_sigma_xx_at_0_a: 3*T = 30 (interpretation of the solution, NOT a separately enforced pointwise acceptance criterion)
reference_values.kirsch_closed_form: u_x, u_y per §6 with r, theta, q = a/r, kappa = 3 - 4*nu; sigma_xx = T*[1 - q^2*(1.5*cos2θ + cos4θ) + 1.5*q^4*cos4θ]; sigma_θθ = T*(1 - 2*cos2θ) on hole boundary

title: Infinite plate with hole (Kirsch, nearly incompressible, stabilized continuous pressure)
